div.head: Had 9.1
div.ab: Et de emendatione ordinis una pars episcopo, altera (secunda sit) altari, et tertia societati.
[9, 1] Et erunt (iste) iuste episcopi et pauperum.
And hadbot mid rihte án dæl þam biscope, oðer þam wibede ⁊ þridde geferscipe.
⁊ hádbot mid rihte án dǽl þam bissceope, oðer þam wibede ⁊ þrydde geferscipe.
[9, 1] ⁊ hadbot mid ryhte an dæl þam biscope, oðer ðam wigbede ⁊ þridde þam gefærscipe.
And hadbot mid rihte an dæl þam biscope, oðer þam wigbede and þridde þam gefærscipe.
Und Klerusbusse [gehört] von rechtswegen ein [Dritt]theil dem Bischof, der zweite dem Altar und der dritte dem Stiftsconvent.
And the compensation for orders [belongs] by right one [third] part to the bishop, the second to the altar, and the third to the community [of the church].
And compensation for [offences against those in] orders [belongs] by rights a third to the bishop, the second part to the altar, the third to the community.
And one part of the compensation for one in orders rightly shall go to the bishop, a second part to the altar, and a third part to the community.
div.note: In H, 10 already stood before 9.1 in hq; H's 9.1 follows 10, and after it in the same hand comes the genealogy of the West Saxon kings to Æthelred II, then Af–Ine.; AY: corrected against Rabin p. 18 / 19, October 2026 (was “∅”, now “|”)
And . . . gefærscipe: this clause occurs as 10.1 in H
þridde þam gefærscipe: þridde geferscipe OD
